relocation_line: I will relocate to Brisbane for this role and can start two weeks after an offer.
cover_letter_text:
Hi Cement Australia team,

I'm Marc. I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, and I'd like to start out as a laboratory technician testing construction materials. Your Darra lab tests cement and concrete, and your advert says you train new people through a traineeship, so I wanted to apply.

In the diploma I studied soil testing standards (AS 1289). In the Philippines I did site inspections and quality checks, kept material records and wrote progress reports. These days I work at a bp service station in Melbourne.

I'd move to Brisbane for the job and can start two weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), a White Card and a full Victorian driver's licence. Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
notes: Link-out from SEEK. Trainee lab technician (cement, concrete testing), Darra Brisbane. Advert: experience advantageous not essential.
